claims.statement: For every odd prime power q>=3, the explicit odd-orthogonal-polarity graph H with one removal and two additions has exactly q(q+1)^2/2+1 edges and 2q-4 noninduced four-cycles.
claims.limitation: Local sharpness, no unrestricted supersaturation lower bound.

claims.statement: All such two-addition/one-deletion edits have at least 2q-3 C4.
claims.limitation: False for every odd prime power; q=3 gives 2 rather than 3.

claims.statement: Adding a nonedge to a polarity graph produces q-1/q/q+1 C4; q-1 exactly for degree-q endpoints.
